action: First anomaly: a spiral that opens into a triangle, folded in itself. It resolves from static in three places with the same proportions each time: the screech of the 4, the heater upstairs, the hiss between radio stations. Match-cuts between the three. JC loses a whole Saturday ('I fall in and send a postcard').
truth: Animatic spec: held keyframes, slates and procedural FX. Not production animation.
